description:
Post a paid task for a real human (online or physical, on site). Returns a task id, the price and the due time.

    deadline (required): ISO 8601, at least 4 hours ahead, e.g. 2026-10-20T18:00:00+02:00. price_eur = budget plus a fee that
    depends on the deadline: from 72 h 20 %, from 24 h 30 %, from 4 h 50 % (all incl. VAT); taken from your account credit, the task is visible to
    humans at once. Returned in full if you cancel before a human accepts or if it is not done by the deadline (status expired).
    title: short summary. description: what exactly should be done and what counts as done.
    budget: what the human gets, in EUR (10 to 500).
    location: city or address if the task is on site.

    api_key: optional, your API key if you cannot set the Authorization header.
name: rent_a_human
